plugins.name: apollo
plugins.description: 3 pre-built skills that chain multiple Apollo APIs into complete sales workflows — no manual steps, no tab switching. Enrich any contact from a name, email, or LinkedIn URL. Prospect by describing your ICP in plain English and get ranked leads. Find, enrich, and load contacts into a sequence in one shot.

skills.name: enrich-lead
skills.description: Instant lead enrichment. Drop a name, company, LinkedIn URL, or email and get the full contact card with email, phone, title, company intel, and next actions.

skills.name: prospect
skills.description: Full ICP-to-leads pipeline. Describe your ideal customer in plain English and get a ranked table of enriched decision-maker leads with emails and phone numbers.

skills.name: sequence-load
skills.description: Find leads matching criteria and bulk-add them to an Apollo outreach sequence. Handles enrichment, contact creation, deduplication, and enrollment in one flow.

headings: Apollo Plugin for Claude Code and Cowork
